# Data Source: identitynow_data_segment

Use this data source to look up a data access segment by ID. It uses an experimental API (`X-SailPoint-Experimental` header).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "identitynow_data_segment" "emea" {
  id = "ef38f943-47e9-4562-b5bb-8424a56397d8"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Data segment ID.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation date.
- `description` (String) Segment description.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the segment is active.
- `member_filter_json` (String) Member filter as a JSON object.
- `member_selection` (Attributes List) Identities selected as members, with `id` and `type`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--member_selection))
- `membership` (String) How members are chosen, `ALL`, `FILTER` or `SELECTION`.
- `modified` (String) Last modification date.
- `name` (String) Segment business name.
- `published` (Boolean) Whether the segment is published.
- `scopes_json` (String) Scopes of the segment as a JSON array.

<a id="nestedatt--member_selection"></a>
### Nested Schema for `member_selection`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Identity ID.
- `type` (String) Object type.
